continuity: Im Chunsoo confirms that Sangdong Guild began investigating the Peace Guild after Im Changsoo was extorted for a hundred million won.
The Security Team's field operation against Jin Taekyung failed; Choi Byungil was defeated and all six Hunters were captured until Team Leader 1 released them.
Im Chunsoo is a Level 75 A-rank ice mage and personally confronts Taekyung after deciding that Taekyung's existence has stirred his interest.
Taekyung's phone contact was Seong Jinho, a thirty-year-old civilian exam candidate and the manager of Taekyung's goshiwon in Bucheon; the two are like sworn brothers.
Kim Hwajong is a Level 80 mage identified as Butler Kim, and he arrives at the confrontation between Im Chunsoo and Taekyung.
plot: Im Chunsoo learns that the investigation into the Peace Guild failed, that Hong Woojin disappeared, and that the Security Team was probably defeated by Jin Taekyung. He identifies Seong Jinho as Taekyung's goshiwon manager and phone contact, then goes to Ilsan.

Taekyung defeats the six Security Team Hunters, treats their injuries with seized supplies, and confiscates their remaining Equipment and consumables. He intimidates Kim Junsu into revealing that Hong Woojin was a B-rank Familiar mage hired by Team Leader 1 and that the operation was ultimately directed by Im Chunsoo.

Im Chunsoo calls Taekyung, releases the captured Hunters through Team Leader 1, and walks with Taekyung before attacking him with ice spikes as a test. Taekyung counters with Fire Wall, and Level 80 Kim Hwajong arrives at the hiking-trail entrance and addresses Im Chunsoo familiarly.
translation_decisions: Render 아가리 봉인술 as mouth-sealing technique.
Retain Fire Wall as the spell name for 파이어 월.
Render Im Chunsoo's repeated 자네 as you in his blunt, senior voice.
Render 김화종's familiar address 춘수 as Chunsoo.

active_continuity: Sangdong Guild's Security Team was assigned to surveil Jin Taekyung under Im Chunsoo's direction.
Choi Byungil led the failed operation against Taekyung and was defeated alongside the other five field Hunters.
Kim Junsu is the Security Team's sole Familiar mage and revealed the operation's information when Taekyung threatened his remaining hair.
Hong Woojin was a B-rank Familiar mage hired from outside by Team Leader 1.
Taekyung seized the Security Team's supplies, treated the wounded Hunters, and held them until Team Leader 1 released them.
Im Chunsoo initiated the investigation after Im Changsoo was extorted for a hundred million won.
Seong Jinho is Taekyung's thirty-year-old civilian goshiwon manager and sworn-brother-like friend in Bucheon.
Im Chunsoo is a Level 75 A-rank ice mage and Guild Master of Sangdong Guild.
Im Chunsoo attacked Taekyung with roughly a dozen ice spikes after inviting him to walk.
Taekyung evaded the ice spikes by casting Fire Wall.
Kim Hwajong is a Level 80 mage and Butler Kim who arrives at the hiking-trail confrontation.
The property being used as the surveillance base remains unidentified.
The reason Kim Hwajong arrived at the confrontation is unknown.
open_questions: Which of the three recently traded properties is being used by the surveillance personnel?
Whether the black Familiar and Kim Gwondong are operating under the same immediate instructions remains unresolved.
Why Kim Hwajong arrived at the confrontation and what role he intends to play remain unknown.
temporary_decisions: Use mouth-sealing technique for 아가리 봉인술.
Keep Fire Wall as the spell name.
Render Im Chunsoo's 자네 as you while preserving his blunt senior voice.
